title: Vanilla Improvements
description: Vanilla Improvements is a Modpack that aims to improve the Vanilla Experience, with various peformance and quality of life mods.
body:
First Version of Vanilla Improvements! this is so fun!

What is a Vanilla Improvement? well it's a modpack that has all the juicy stuff to make your experience even better! It has a LOT of mods! and some mods that will help you with framerate and peformance. This used to be a modpack for a server that i made with my friends, and now it's time for it to be seen!![Vanilla Improvements Logo!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6670e4d5bf927f83fd5ec501ede88d6e351e20c1.png)
